title: Fixed scalar restriction commutes with the normalized small site coordinates
statement: Let X be a scheme and k a commutative ring in the coefficient universe. Let a be an isomorphism from the small-site pushforward of the constant commutative k-ring sheaf on X_proet to the constant k-ring sheaf on the small site. Suppose a sends every original constant section r on the corresponding site object to the small-site constant section r. Then the composite of sfbFixedScalarRestriction with fixedScalarProEtaleSheafEquivalence.functor is naturally isomorphic to proEtaleModuleToModel followed by commutative scalar restriction along a inverse. The literal fixed-scalar restriction and model functor are those of lem-sfb-adic-stratified-perfect and def-sfb-fixed-scalar-etale-model.

source.place: Tag 099L, section-derived-completion-noetherian: the completed constant algebra is flat and identifies quotients; Tag 099M, lemma-naive-completion; Cohomology on Sites Tag 06YY, lemma-derived-base-change. Integral-models proof (1)--(2), comparison of the first reductions.

proof.text: Compose with the fully faithful constant scalar restriction functor on the small site. Its counit cancels the inverse functor in the fixed scalar model. Normalization of a and its inverse identity show that the other composite has the same constant scalar action on every section. Identity functions give a natural module isomorphism, which lifts through full faithfulness. This works for zero rings and empty sites.

theorem fixed_scalar_small_coordinates (X : Scheme.{u})
    (k : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing k]
    (a : (sfbModelRings X).obj (adicLisseConstantRing X k) ≅
      ConstantCompletion.constant (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, u} X) k)
    (ha : ∀ (U : coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, u} X) (r : k),
      a.hom.hom.app (op U)
          ((toSheafify (ProEt.topology X)
            ((Functor.const X.ProEtᵒᵖ).obj (CommRingCat.of k))).app
              (op (AsSmall.down.obj U)) r) =
        (toSheafify (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, u} X)
          ((Functor.const (coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, u} X)ᵒᵖ).obj
            (CommRingCat.of k))).app (op U) r) :
    Nonempty (sfbFixedScalarRestriction X k ⋙
        (fixedScalarProEtaleSheafEquivalence X k).functor ≅
      proEtaleModuleToModel ((adicLisseForget X).obj (adicLisseConstantRing X k)) ⋙
        ConstantCompletion.res a.inv)
